title: Computer Science and Engineering | IIT Delhi - Abu Dhabi
description: ###### Postgraduate Programs. The Computer Science and Engineering undergraduate program at IIT Delhi – Abu Dhabi (IITD-AD) equips students to navigate and shape the digital world, offering strong foundations in algorithms, computational thinking, and system design, while providing flexibility to specialize in emerging technologies driving global innovation and industry transformation. Our B.Tech in Computer Science program at IIT Delhi - Abu Dhabi focuses on several major thrust areas essential for today's technological landscape. These core areas form the foundation of our program, equipping students with the skills and knowledge needed to thrive in the dynamic field of computer science. These areas form the cornerstone of our curriculum, providing students with a comprehensive understanding of cutting-edge technologies and preparing them to excel in the rapidly evolving field of computer science. Seize the opportunity to shape tomorrow's world with B.Tech in Computer Science at IIT Delhi - Abu Dhabi.
